messages.subject: For Aziz Aluthman Fakhroo | Digital infrastructure, regional strategy and government relations
messages.body:
Dear Ooredoo Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Aziz Aluthman Fakhroo, Group Chief Executive Officer.

Ooredoo's evolution into a regional digital-infrastructure leader requires disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, infrastructure partners and operating companies. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex cross-functional stakeholder matters.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of government relations, regional strategy and emerging-market execution might support Ooredoo's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Ooredoo Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
